365 Poetry SLC: A Legacy of Spoken Word & Soul
Since around 2012 (over 12+ years strong!), 365 Poetry has been a beloved homegrown open mic in Salt Lake City, founded by Abi Olufeko as a space to celebrate self-love, diversity, and community 365 days a year—in 365 different ways.
What started as an intimate gathering has grown into one of SLC's favorite poetry nights, blending powerful spoken word, live performances, visual art, music, and heartfelt connection. It's an inclusive, welcoming haven for poets, dreamers, thinkers, and anyone who loves words that touch the soul.
